items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: From backstage I see a gentleman, sitting up, taking a bow, picking up a pair of sticks, and he sounded [scats].

ctx.x: Proximity, yeah. So anyway the master of ceremony for the concert, it was the boss of the Hot Club there, he said, “Okay tonight ladies and gentlemen, welcome. Please welcome, on the drums Mr. — I remember the name — Mr. Bill English. From backstage I see a gentleman, sitting up, taking a bow, picking up a pair of sticks, and he sounded [scats]. And then while playing the hi-hat, the guy announces that on bass we have a gentleman, his name, please welcome Mr. Jimmy Rowser, never heard of. And I see this big guy…
Okay. Walking bass. Yeah. The first time you heard the double bass.
